run: set PCONF_CONFIG=<platform config>; python -B -m unittest discover -s conformance -t . -p 'test_*.py'
coversGates: CON-05 capability union and conformance floor (2.1.0 §3.3/§3.5)
D-27: positive and negative cases for legal unsealed v1.2/v1.3 run-locks
D-35: declared script support requires an explicit scriptEnvironmentRungs entry
conform: python -B -m conformance.conform --config "$PCONF_CONFIG" --out floor.json   # single-cell re-check: add --only <softwareId>
releaseScope: D-27: adds a positive/negative conformance regression for the legal no-sealed-environment run-lock shape in v1.2 and v1.3. D-35: conform marks a declared script action unverified unless the platform config explicitly declares a structurally usable scriptEnvironmentRungs entry. Declared-absent platforms remain declaredAbsent. No execution policy is inferred from the legacy executionBackend field.
